Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DMHO Ri Bhoi Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Medical Officer post is scheduled for 02 September 2026. Candidates are advised to report within the specified time for registration.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Medical Officer post is MBBS from a recognized Institution and registration under SMC/NMC.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the Medical Officer posts ranges from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 60,000 per month, depending on the specific posting.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Medical Officer post announced by DMHO Ri Bhoi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates may report along with the original documents to the office of the undersigned between 10:30 am to 11:30 am on 02 September 2026 for the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in the office of the District Medical & Health Officer (DMHO), Nongpoh.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original documents and self-attested copies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and registration certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit mentioned for the Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention an age limit. It is advisable to check the detailed notification for any specific age criteria or relaxation details.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a screening process followed by a walk-in interview.
